categories.main_business_segments: Yeong Hwa Metal Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the manufacturing and sales of cast metal materials for automotive parts. The company produces and sells automotive components through its foundry and processing plants, focusing on casting and machining operations. It also engages in the sale of related products and by-products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced casting technologies including IMS-1 and DISA molding lines for producing automotive parts. Production capacity is measured in tons for casting and units for machining, with a focus on high tensile strength and precision required for automotive safety components. Raw materials include scrap iron, pig iron, coke, and stainless steel scrap sourced domestically and imported, with production processes optimized for automotive-grade metal parts.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Yeong Hwa Metal serves major automotive manufacturers and parts suppliers, including GM Daewoo, Renault Samsung, and other automotive component buyers such as Samsin Precision, Namyang Nexmo, Taiyo Korea, and BorgWarner Turbo Systems. The company’s products are sold both domestically and internationally, with export sales constituting a significant portion of revenue.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in South Korea with manufacturing facilities located in Changwon (Jinhae district) and Ham-an. It exports automotive parts globally, engaging with overseas buyers through export orders and letters of credit. Key raw materials are also imported, notably coke from China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yeong Hwa Metal operates upstream to midstream in the automotive supply chain, focusing on the production of cast metal components that serve as essential materials for automotive parts manufacturers. It supplies these components to downstream automotive assembly and parts companies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company is pursuing business diversification by adding new business purposes related to secondary battery electrolyte additives, semiconductor and related device manufacturing, and software consulting and development. However, these new business areas are currently not active and are under consideration for future growth. The core focus remains on improving product quality, delivery compliance, and participation in material development for automotive parts.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of manufactured automotive cast parts and related products. Sales are conducted via direct orders from domestic and international customers, with export transactions managed through letters of credit and domestic sales through purchase orders. The company does not currently engage in subscription or licensing models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Yeong Hwa Metal is positioned as a leading company in the automotive casting industry in South Korea, recognized for its advanced casting technology and product quality. The industry is competitive due to globalization and price competition, with the company focusing on securing export clients and maintaining stable order volumes. Specific competitors are not named in the report.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported revenues of approximately 292.3 billion KRW in 2023, a 2.6% increase from the previous year, with operating profit turning positive to about 9.4 billion KRW. Net income rose significantly to 7.5 billion KRW. Total assets stood at around 210 billion KRW with a decrease in liabilities and an improved debt ratio of 211%. Production volumes showed a slight decline, reflecting operational adjustments including the sale of a processing plant.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yeong Hwa Metal emphasizes high-quality, precision casting technology critical for automotive safety components, leveraging advanced production capabilities and stable supply of raw materials. The company’s value lies in its ability to meet stringent automotive industry standards, maintain delivery reliability, and engage in material development to support customer product innovation. Its strategic diversification efforts also aim to create future growth opportunities beyond traditional casting.
